positioning.label: LinkedIn About, paragraph 1
positioning.text: I bring 20+ years of experience spanning energy analytics, construction project management, electronics, RF systems, and emerging technologies. My career has focused on delivering scalable solutions, optimizing data workflows, and leading cross-functional teams to achieve measurable results.

positioning.label: LinkedIn About, paragraph 2
positioning.text: I’ve managed federal, DoD, and private-sector construction projects up to $20M, overseeing multiple crews and subcontractors, ensuring quality control, and driving projects from pre-construction through closeout. In the energy sector, I’ve structured and analyzed electricity pricing across PJM, ERCOT, NYISO, and ISONE, built automation pipelines with Python and PostgreSQL, and developed dashboards and tools that improved operational efficiency.

positioning.label: LinkedIn About, paragraph 3
positioning.text: Whether integrating edge-computing IoT systems for first responders, repairing advanced RF electronics, or leading construction crews in the field, I combine hands-on technical expertise with project leadership. I thrive in fast-paced environments, adapt quickly to new challenges, and have a consistent track record of helping organizations innovate, scale, and succeed.

positioning.label: LinkedIn Areas of Expertise
positioning.text: Construction Project Management • Energy Market Analytics • Data Analysis • Python • PostgreSQL • RF & SDR Systems • Systems Integration • Electronics & Testing • Operations Management • Project Leadership • Customer Success

positioning.label: Resume profile
positioning.text: Motivated, data-driven professional with 20+ years of experience across data consulting, energy analytics, electronics, operations, RF and SDR technology, systems engineering, and construction project management. Combines deep technical knowledge with leadership in startup and operational environments. Adept at designing scalable solutions, optimizing data workflows, and delivering hands-on innovations across disciplines. Seeking a high-impact, ownership-oriented role in a tech-forward company.
